recommendations.body:
`## Applicable guardrails` in `03-move-plan-scope-fence-rendering-shared.md` (step 3 "Move the plan scope-fence rendering into a shared leaf module") quotes the plan's "Allowed behavior changes" clause as *"rendered input reaching three consumers across five templates — `detail.md` and `detail-jira.md`, `run.md` and `run-jira.md`, and `plan-audit.md`"*, but `2-intent-scope-fence.md`'s `## Out of scope` allows *"rendered input reaching four templates — `detail.md`, `detail-jira.md`, `run.md`, `run-jira.md`"* and names no `plan-audit.md`. The code follows the plan — `plan_tool/prompts/plan-audit.md` has no `${scope_fence_block}` slot and `renderer.py` feeds only the four allowed templates — so the fence quote, not the implementation, is the stale piece; left standing it reads as authorizing a fifth consumer the plan permanently excludes. The same superseded quote sits in the sibling details `04-render-plan-step-intent-shared-fence.md:178` and `05-pass-both-fence-halves-run-run-jira.md:183`, so the correction is a three-file sweep

## Redirect

- **Reason**: the detail files quote a pre-carve version of the plan's scope fence; the plan and the code already agree on four templates, so the detail prose is the piece that needs amending
- **Suggested next**: detail --reconcile
